events.region: Pecos; Davis Mountains Foothills; Central Brewster County
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 1200 AM CST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 11
miles northeast of Alpine, moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

This storm will remain over mainly rural areas of southwestern
Pecos, northwestern Brewster and eastern Jeff Davis Counties
including near U.S. Highway 67
.

hydration.
